Sound sources (CC0 1.0):
Ice moving in glass — Rvgerxini
https://freesound.org/people/Rvgerxini/sounds/464451/
50 RPG sound effects — Kenney
https://opengameart.org/content/50-rpg-sound-effects
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Edited for dovemayo: short excerpts, mono conversion, EQ, level matching, fades.
Ice samples: ice-0/1/2. Book flips: paper-0/1/2. Cloth: cloth-0/1. Book close: soft.

Additional sources (CC0 1.0):
Bubbles pop: https://opengameart.org/content/bubbles-pop
Wine Glasses on contact (Clink) — EpicWizard: https://freesound.org/people/EpicWizard/sounds/325194/
Underwater Ambience — Kinoton: https://freesound.org/people/Kinoton/sounds/393819/
Bubble/wine excerpts equalized and faded; underwater excerpt filtered and crossfaded into a loop. Tooth and shoe use Kenney book flip and footstep recordings.

Clarity revision: wine-clear isolates the 3.08 kHz wineglass ring; underwater-clear removes sub-260 Hz rumble and retains water detail up to 3.5 kHz. Same CC0 sources above.

Additional CC0 sources, edited excerpts:
Apple - bite 01 — Anthousai: https://freesound.org/people/Anthousai/sounds/398756/
Page Turn (1) — OwlStorm: https://freesound.org/people/OwlStorm/sounds/151220/
WaterBottle.wav — MCYost: https://freesound.org/s/146334/ (beer and non-vocal low water gag)
Bubbles 001.wav — ristooooo1: https://freesound.org/s/539823/ (six separate bubbles)
44.1 kHz excerpts, gentle filtering, level matching and edge fades. No human voice used for eggplant.

Softer sound revision:
Beer pour: water-pour-01 from Fantasy Sound Effects (Tinysized SFX), CC0: https://opengameart.org/content/fantasy-sound-effects-tinysized-sfx
Chili: Catching fire, CC0: https://opengameart.org/content/catching-fire
Page-soft: prior OwlStorm source, softened EQ and longer fade-in.
Bubble-deep and tooth-soft: prior ristooooo1 water-bubble source, pitch/filter/envelope edits.
